entities.name: N-benzyl pyrrolidine substrate
observations: SELFIES corresponds to OCCNCC1CCN(Cc2ccccc2)C1, an N-benzylated pyrrolidine bearing a hydroxyethylamino-methyl substituent.

entities.name: H2/Pd in methanol
observations: Hydrogenation conditions are consistent with cleavage of the N-benzyl protecting group; Pd is supplied in the reactants.
